label: HABIT 1
head: Calling laziness rest
sub: Rest comes after work. A 4-hour nap on a day you did nothing is hiding.

label: HABIT 2
head: Low-effort friends
sub: If nobody around you trains, saves or builds, you won't either.

label: HABIT 3
head: No routine
sub: Same wake time, same gym time. Decide once, stop negotiating daily.

label: HABIT 4
head: Never investing in you
sub: A good haircut, a gym month, one book. Cheaper than one night out.

label: HABIT 5
head: Fearing what they'll think
sub: Nobody at the gym is watching you. They're checking their own form.

head: Your Saturday
l: Sleeps till noon, scrolls till dinner
r: Gym at 9, haircut at 11, friends at 7
